title: SACPVP Notice – 2026/2027 Annual Fees
shortDescription: Annual fee invoices for 2026/2027 will be issued in April 2026, including a 3% increase and updated CPD compliance requirements.
content:
NOTICE: 2026/2027 ANNUAL FEES

The South African Council for the Property Valuers Profession (SACPVP) hereby informs all Registered Persons that:

1. Invoices for the 2026/2027 annual fees will be emailed during the first week of April 2026. A 3% increase in annual fees has been approved.

2. Updated Annual Fees:
- Professional Valuer: R5 180.00
- Professional Associated Valuer: R4 780.00
- Single Residential Property Assessor: R4 780.00
- Candidate Valuer (+5 years): R4 460.00
- Candidate Valuer (-5 years): R1 670.00
- Professional Octogenarians: R1 055.00

3. Professional Valuers:
- Registration Certificates may be requested once annual fees are paid
- CPD compliance is mandatory
- Non-compliance results in a 1-year certificate validity
- Compliance ensures a 5-year certificate validity

4. Professional Associated Valuers & SRPAs:
- Same conditions apply regarding payment and CPD compliance

5. Candidate Valuers & CSRPA:
- First and second-year candidates receive a 1-year certificate upon payment
- Final-year or completed candidates must submit proof of enrolment or academic progress
- Eligible candidates will receive a 5-year certificate

Failure to comply with CPD requirements will affect certificate validity.

title: Board Examination Venues & Instructions – 25 March 2026
shortDescription: Official venue confirmations and examination instructions for candidates writing the 25 March 2026 SACPVP Board Examination.
content:
ANNOUNCEMENT

The South African Council for the Property Valuers Profession (SACPVP) wishes all candidates well for the Board Examination scheduled on 25 March 2026.

This announcement provides the official examination venues per region, as well as important instructions applicable to all candidates.

EXAMINATION DETAILS:
- Format: In-person (physical pen and paper)
- Type: Closed book examination
- Duration: 3 hours
- Time: 10:00 – 13:00
- Arrival: Candidates must be seated by 09:45

IMPORTANT RULES:
- No entry after 11:00
- No leaving before 11:00 (unless approved by invigilator)
- Bring valid ID or driver's licence
- Only allowed items: pen, ruler, calculator

Laptop Users:
- Complete Sections A & B first
- Submit hard copy before opening spreadsheet
- No returning to earlier sections after opening laptop

Failure to comply with rules may result in disciplinary action.

Please download your relevant venue PDF below for exact location details.

title: 2025-2026 Examination Information
shortDescription: Important information regarding the upcoming professional examinations for the 2025-2026 academic year.
content:
The South African Institute of Valuers is pleased to announce the examination schedule for the 2025-2026 academic year.

Examination Details:
- Registration opens: January 15, 2025
- Registration closes: March 31, 2025
- Examination dates: June 2025 and November 2025
- Results release: Within 8 weeks of examination

Candidates are advised to review the examination guidelines and ensure all prerequisites are met before registration. Study materials and preparation courses will be available through our approved education providers.

title: Announcement of New SACPVP Council Members
shortDescription: Two new members appointed to the 6th Council of the SACPVP following recent resignations.
content:
Following the resignation of two members from the 6th Council of the South African Council for the Property Valuers Profession (SACPVP), the Honourable Minister Mr. D Macpherson has appointed two new Council members.

These appointments are effective immediately and will remain in place until September 2026.

The updated 6th Council now includes:
- Mr. John Frederick Cloete (President)
- Ms. Tiny Dlamini (Vice President)
- Ms. Mankuroane Matseba
- Mr. Manyane Chidi
- Ms. Rehab Letsaba
- Ms. Hendrina Viljoen
- Mr. Gregory Cowden
- Mr. Rakesh Ramlugaan
- Mr. JF du Toit (Saul)
- Mr. MPL Mthuli (Malusi)

The announcement also includes the appointment of new administrative staff to strengthen Council operations.

title: Board Examination Notice – March 2026
shortDescription: Applications open for the 19 March 2026 Board Examination. Closing date: 05 December 2025. Courier/hand-delivery only.
content:
The SACPVP is accepting Board exam applications for 19 March 2026. Submit by courier or hand delivery to Mr. Ntsweng; email submissions are NOT accepted. Closing date: 05 December 2025.

Who can apply:
- Registered Candidate Valuers (≥2 years) with accredited Real Estate qualification
- Registered Professional Associated Valuers
- Pr AVals may apply for Pr Val admission exam if they meet degree and tenure requirements

Application pack includes:
- Completed application (incl. Experience Matrix + supporting docs)
- Certified qualifications + transcripts (≤3 months old)
- Certified ID/passport + valid work permit (if applicable)
- Detailed CV
- Supervisor/mentor letter (with SACPVP reg no. + postal address)
- Practical Workschool certificate (compulsory)

Notes:
- Prior unsuccessful candidates and previously approved but unable-to-write candidates should NOT submit new applications—email confirmation before the closing date suffices.
- Exam will be held in a physical/contact session.

Fees (VAT incl.; 50% refundable until 14 days before Exam):
- Pr AVal exam: R3,700.00
- Pr AVal writing Pr Val exam: R4,000.00
(Payment requested once application is approved.)
